text:
If you’re hoping to catch a decent sunset, keep expectations modest: clouds have the sky covered, and a shower could move through this evening. Rain becomes more likely overnight, with a quarter to half-inch possible and temperatures sliding to around 47. The north wind will ease, but the lake is still running 1 to 3 feet tonight, so it’s not a great evening for an outing on the water.

Tuesday looks like the wet day we’ve been watching, and the forecast has gotten wetter. Expect periods of rain, a high near 59, and a south wind that could gust to 26 mph. The forecasters’ own discussion points to a stalled boundary keeping the rain going, with 1 to 2 inches possible. On the lake, waves may build to 5 to 7 feet, so plan on staying ashore. Bring rain gear for any Tuesday plans, and allow extra time for a soggy, breezy day.
